- This is the last update of Spytify 1
- When Spytify 2 is out, a new app for Windows, macOS and Linux, Spytify will tell you and open its download page
- Fixed the FAQ and Donate links: the website moved to spytify.github.io/spytify

Spytify moved to [github.com/spytify/spytify](https://github.com/spytify/spytify). Spytify 1 will not get any more updates; Spytify 2 replaces it.
